meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一个研究问题,拿到带引用、经过复核的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常遇到需要系统查证、逐条引用来源的复杂调研任务
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research question into a cited, reviewed report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face complex questions needing systematic, cited investigation

howto.what: 触发后它会先亮出 ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED!,自建研究小组分工搜集,让成员互相辩论,必要时跑代码验证,最后交付每条结论都带引用或证据的报告(默认 PDF+DOCX)。
howto.when: 只在用户明确要求研究或深度调查时接管,例如说出 “ulw-research”、任何带 “ulw” 的研究措辞,或明确要求做深度研究;普通提问、调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我彻底研究一下这个主题
say.note: 它会先问你要什么格式,再组建团队

say.text: ulw-research 深挖这个方案的可信度,争议处跑代码验证
say.note: 成员会就受质疑的结论互相辩论

say.text: ulw-research 研究这个问题,输出 PDF 和 DOCX
say.note: 按你选定的格式交付带引用的报告

howto.what_en: Once triggered it prints ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED!, builds a team to split the search, has members debate contested claims, runs code to verify when needed, and delivers a report with a citation or proof per claim (PDF+DOCX default).
howto.when_en: Activates only when the user explicitly asks for research or deep investigation — "ulw-research", any "ulw" research phrasing, or "ultradebate"/"hyperdebate" requests.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to dig into this topic exhaustively.
say_en.note: It asks your format first, then builds the team.

say_en.text: ulw-research this proposal and verify contested points with code.
say_en.note: Members debate the claims that are under attack.

say_en.text: ulw-research this and deliver a PDF and DOCX.
say_en.note: You get a cited report in the format you chose.
